bottleneck.description: Only scaled rare-earth separator outside China and the first commercial producer of separated heavy rare earths (dysprosium, terbium) ex-China.

dependency.key_customers: JARE (JOGMEC/Sojitz), Japanese magnet makers, US DoD-funded Texas separation, European auto/wind OEMs
dependency.key_suppliers: Internal Mt Weld ore; reagents, fuel, regional power

editorial.notes: Lynas operates the only fully integrated mine-to-separated-oxide rare earth supply chain outside China (Mt Weld mine, Kalgoorlie cracking-and-leaching, Malaysia separation, Kalgoorlie heavy REE expansion). First Dy shipments achieved 1H FY26, Tb following, with the JARE/Japan offtake extended to 2038 at a $110/kg NdPr floor. With China dominating ~90% of separation and Beijing imposing heavy-REE export controls, Western OEMs (Japan, US DoD, EU) have effectively no other near-term option — multi-year qualification and capital-intensity make substitution prohibitive. HIGH is appropriate (CRITICAL reserved for sole-source feedstock like 600111 C1).
